item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.3.4.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.3.4/Leise-2.3.4.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.3.4
- **Percentages come out the same way in every language.** „百分之六点四" becomes `6.4%`, "five percent" becomes `5%`, and „50 Prozent" becomes `50 %` (German spacing). - **Polishing no longer puts spaces between Chinese words.** The space between Chinese and Latin letters or digits (`是 6.4%`, `用 Leise`) stays as before. - **Correcting the same word a second time now sticks.** If Leise keeps getting a name wrong after you correct it, the second correction makes that word always part of what recognition listens for, and the banner says so — it no longer repeats "added to dictionary" when nothing changed. - **Update checks are on by default.** Leise asks once more if you said no before; the check only downloads the update feed. You can turn it off in Settings at any time. - **"Pause media while recording" is gone.** It relied on a component Leise no longer ships. Muting system audio while you dictate works as before (Settings → Audio).
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** (on-device polishing additionally needs a newer macOS with Apple Intelligence; without it Leise Engine uses its bundled model) · about **5–7 GB free disk** (app + speech models; 2.1 GB less when your Mac's built-in intelligence does the polishing).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
